 TITABAR, DIST. JORHAT, ASSAM  VERSUS
THE STATE OF ASSAM
REPRESENTED BY THE PUBLIC PROSECUTOR, ASSAM Advocate for the Petitioner : MR S BORTHAKUR Advocate for the Respondent : PP, ASSAM
BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE KALYAN RAI SURANA  ORDER Date : 20.02.2023 Heard Mr. P. Singha, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Also heard Mr. M.P.
Goswami, learned APP appearing for the State.

2. The petitioner, who was arrested and forwarded on 23.12.2022, is Page No.# 2/3 seeking regular bail under section 439 Cr.P.C. in connection with Titabar P.S. Case No. 167/2022, under sections 406/420 IPC, added sections 120B IPC, read with section 21/23 of the Banning of Unregulated Dhruba Jyoti Saikia vs The State Of Assam on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85912542/
1 Deposit Schemes Act, 2019, read with section 4/5 of Prize Chits and Money Circulation Scheme (Banning) Act, 1978, corresponding to G.R. Case No. 437/2022, pending before the Court of learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate (M), Titabar.

sentences.text: 3. The learned APP has produced the case diary and opposed the prayer for bail.

4. On perusal of the case diary, it appears that there are sufficient incriminating materials against the petitioner of inducing people to invest in the unregulated deposit scheme and money circulation scheme.

5. Nonetheless, as the petitioner is in custody for last 59 days, considering the length of detention,
the Court is inclined to grant bail to the petitioner, namely, Dhruba Jyoti Saikia in connection with the aforesaid case on furnishing bail bond of Rs.1,00,000/- with two solvent sureties of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate (M), Titabar.
Out of the two sureties, one should offer his/her immovable property as security for grant of bail, having sufficient value to cover the bail amount.

6. Bail is granted on the following conditions:
I. The petitioner shall make himself available to the police or any other investigating agency or Court in the present case as and when required.
II.

The petitioner shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case Page No.# 3/3 so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
He shall not, in any manner, try to overawe or influence or intimidate the prosecution witness.
III. The petitioner shall not obstruct the smooth progress of the investigation/trial.
IV. The petitioner shall not misuse his liberty in any manner.

V. The petitioner shall appear before the I/O within 10 (ten) days from the date of his release and he shall continue to appear once in every month till his appearance is dispensed with or charge-sheet is filed, whichever is earlier.
7.
This application stands disposed of.
8. Case diary is returned.
